senses.definition: (ergative) To burn something to charcoal; to be burnt to charcoal.
(transitive) To burn (something) severely, so as to blacken it.
examples: The fire charred her down to the bone.

senses.definition: (transitive) To burn (something) slightly or superficially so as to affect colour.
examples: The chef charred the scallops just right.

senses.definition: Any of the several species of fishes of the genus Salvelinus.

senses.definition: (obsolete) A time; a turn or occasion.
(obsolete) A turn of work; a labour or item of business.
